target_customer: UK tradespeople and home improvement contractors who want to offer finance to homeowners
problem: Small contractors lose jobs to bigger firms that can offer customers credit, because they cannot access consumer finance themselves.
business_model: Credit broker model: contractors (introducer appointed representatives) introduce customers to partner lenders; Kanda earns broker commission
product_category: Point of sale consumer finance for trades

founders.name: Richard Fleeman
prior_employers: Ran his own electrical contracting business for 10 years
founders.background_notes: Came up with the idea after losing jobs to firms that offered customer credit (YC page).

founders.name: Rob Gallagher
education: PhD in astrophysics, University of Cambridge
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; started Kanda while writing his thesis.

exit.reason: Kanda Products and Services Ltd entered liquidation on 6 May 2026; the FCA gives no reason but says Kanda had agreed restrictions on 16 February 2026 to address weaknesses in its systems and controls.

technical_complexity.rationale: Quote and finance application software; the hard part was regulatory authorisation and lender relationships.

defensibility.rationale: Lender partnerships and FCA authorisation help, but other brokers offered similar installer finance.

incumbents: Established UK point of sale lenders and brokers
takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; the company entered liquidation in 2026.

market_need_then: Founder experience of losing jobs for lack of customer credit; the FCA states Kanda ended with a network of around 700 tradespeople, showing real uptake.

branding.domain_note: Used getkanda.com, which redirects to grow.kanda.co.uk; acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: Black and green logo files published for partners
identity.voice_and_tone: Simple, tradesperson focused (Notion marketing guide for partners)

brand_strength.rationale: Partner asset pages and review pages exist but no press on the brand; name is shared with other firms.

outcome_analysis: Kanda built a broker network of around 700 tradespeople in the UK, then agreed to FCA restrictions on appointing new representatives in February 2026 over weaknesses in systems and controls, and its main entity entered liquidation on 6 May 2026. The FCA does not state the cause of the liquidation, so the regulatory factor is an inference from the sequence; no funding history beyond YC was found.
notes: The directory status says Active but the FCA reports liquidation of Kanda Products and Services Ltd on 6 May 2026, so exit is recorded as shutdown; the FCA says Kanda remains authorised as a credit broker for now. An aggregator (Extruct) lists a $125,000 round on 2021-03-20 with YC and FJ Labs, unverified so not recorded. The YC page fetched names Fleeman and Gallagher; one search snippet showed Phillip Daneshyar as a YC founder and a wefunder page exists (kingscrowd link returned 403), so crowdfunding is possible but unverified. Company website redirect target returned 503. No dated UK competitor source found; Kandoo, Ideal4Finance, Vendigo and Phoenix FC appear only in 2026 pages, and US names Hearth and GreenSky are US market players, so the list is empty.
